needed.evidence: No footway visible on the left side of the road, with no physical barrier or sidewalk
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide safe pedestrian pathways.

needed.evidence: Obstructions on the right-side footway, making it partly unusable
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions to ensure the entire width of the narrow footway is clear and usable.

needed.evidence: Uneven and potentially hazardous sections under footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the hazardous sections of the footway on the right side to prevent tripping accidents.

needed.evidence: No crossing facility at points where pedestrians need to cross
needed.suggestion: Introduce marked pedestrian crossings where crossing demand is high, especially near intersections and main pedestrian activity points.

needed.evidence: Insufficient street lights along the road, especially in urban areas
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights along the road to enhance safety and visibility during low-light conditions.
